fusions.name: Overdrawn Shaft
fusions.desc: Draws the string past full draw and looses one arrow for 34 damage that ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Fistful Loose
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once in a spread out to 8 tiles, each dealing 6 damage. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Long-Armed Draw
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Drawn Through Pain
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (272% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
